reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited compensation provisions (§3(a)-(b)) contain no most-favoured-nation mechanic of any kind, so there is no obligation on Company/Clear Capital to extend Contractor terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers — this matches the rule's preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer).
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed; the rendered text is identical to the original and no deterministic checks failed.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped: it notes the absence of a Vendor-granted MFN as a non-required nicety and correctly defers the unilateral 30-day rate-change right in §3(b) to the price-increase rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
